name: Trinity College Dublin
summary: Dublin city-centre university founded in 1592; 121 undergraduate courses through CAO; its entry rule asks for English, Maths and a second language.

ib.text: 3 HL at 5 and 3 SL at 4 in one sitting, including English (SL 4), Maths and another language. Stricter courses: Mathematics needs HL Maths 6, Engineering HL Maths 5; Medicine HL 6 and 5 in two sciences.

programmes.name: Medicine
programmes.about: Five years of medicine in Dublin: the biomedical sciences first, clinical training starting early through problem-based learning and small groups, then hospital placements as a member of the care team.
programmes.ib: HL 5 and 6 in two of Physics, Chemistry and Biology (Maths SL 5 if you have no Physics), inside Trinity's six-subject rule. HPAT-Ireland is required.

needs.note: Two of these sciences: one at 6, the other at 5
Only if you do not present Physics

programmes.selectionNote: Every EU applicant sits HPAT-Ireland in the year they enter, and needs at least 480 CAO points; places go on CAO points and the test.

flagshipSource.title: Trinity School of Medicine: founded in 1711, a central role in Irish medicine (course page)

programmes.name: Engineering
programmes.about: Two common years of mathematics, physics, chemistry and computing, then a choice of six engineering disciplines; five years lead to a Masters, with a BAI honours degree as an optional exit.
programmes.ib: HL Mathematics 5 (AA strongly recommended), inside Trinity's rule of 3 HL at 5 and 3 SL at 4, including English and another language.
programmes.selectionNote: Places go on CAO points alone; Trinity converts your IB total with its own table and adds 25 points for HL Maths at grade 4 or better.

flagshipSource.title: Engineering at Trinity: taught since 1841, accredited by Engineers Ireland, dual Masters with Columbia

programmes.name: Philosophy
programmes.about: Reason and argument applied to existence, value and society: metaphysics, epistemology, ethics, political philosophy and philosophy of mind, with room to specialise in the later years. A small intake of 20.
programmes.ib: No extra subject: Trinity's rule of 3 HL at 5 and 3 SL at 4, including English, Maths and another language.
programmes.selectionNote: Places go on CAO points alone; Trinity converts your IB total with its own table (36 IB points is about 496 CAO points).

flagshipSource.title: Philosophy at Trinity: analytic approach, specialists, graduates winning International Undergraduate Awards prizes

faculties.name: Faculty of Arts, Humanities and Social Sciences
faculties.line: Twelve schools teach its undergraduate courses; each course page states its own extra requirements.

faculties.name: Faculty of Health Sciences
faculties.line: Medicine needs two HL sciences (5 and 6), at least 480 CAO points and HPAT-Ireland in your year of entry.

faculties.name: Faculty of Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics
faculties.line: Engineering and Computer Science ask HL Maths 5; Mathematics asks HL Maths 6.

notes: Medicine (TR051) is restricted: you sit HPAT-Ireland in your year of entry, and IB applicants need HL 6 and 5 in two of Physics, Chemistry and Biology.
The Bachelor in Acting is not on CAO: you apply through The Lir Academy by early February and audition between November and March.
Both IB maths courses are accepted, but for maths-intensive courses Trinity strongly recommends HL Maths: Analysis and Approaches.
